description: Language-agnostic law of the input funnel's identity gate: a user input waits (bounded) for the held hub session's identity only while the hub granted a session the shell has not resolved to a human yet — not without a session, not once the identity is known, not for a refused session, not during a shortage (an unreachable hub keeps the last identity and never blocks). Measured cause: the first Create Space within ~2 s of signing in was refused `s.home.session-identity-required` (ticket 26/09/23, S18 §14b).

cases.name: a just-granted session not yet resolved waits
a resolved session does not wait
a refused session does not wait
